items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Recommend blocking new public exposure, go-live, and security-sensitive releases; no clean bill of health or certification is supported. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or findings; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS controls, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness remain unknown. Compliance reports 36 pass, 19 fail, and 6 unknown; HTTPS checks alone do not establish complete TLS control evidence. SearchWoot remains private pending completion of its existing legal, security, accuracy, measurement, and owner gates. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, cross-site behavior, or new public exposure.

Retain the existing read-only security evidence matrix; do not request duplicate telemetry, retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, deploy, add dependencies, or conduct external outreach. Record dated evidence, unknowns, affected scope, owners, severity, and release implications for authentication, access boundaries, secrets, isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain risk, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and security.txt or disclosure readiness.
